title: galium heldreichii subsp. protopycnotrichum
intro: Galium heldreichii subsp. protopycnotrichum, commonly known as the Bosnian bedstraw, is a plant species within the family Rubiaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage.
